mapper.select: /* AiBugReportMapper.selectBugReportDetail */ SELECT br.id, br.conversation_id, br.message_id, br.error_type, br.severity, br.description, br.screenshot_url, br.status, br.reported_by, br.reported_at, br.resolved_by, br.resolved_at, br.resolution_note, c.title AS conversation_title, c.mode AS conversation_mode, c.context_label AS conversation_context_label, m.content AS message_content, m.role AS message_role, reporter.email AS reporter_email, resolver.email AS resolver_email FROM ai_bug_report br INNER JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.id = br.conversation_id LEFT JOIN ai_message m ON m.id = br.message_id INNER JOIN `user` reporter ON reporter.user_no = br.reported_by LEFT JOIN `user` resolver ON resolver.user_no = br.resolved_by WHERE br.id = #{id}
mapper.update: /* AiBugReportMapper.updateBugReportStatus */ UPDATE ai_bug_report SET status = #{status}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
